causal_risk: TTFT and prefill variance are runtime-version-sensitive.
Prefix-cache behavior and metric semantics may differ across vLLM versions.
Worker memory pressure and scheduler behavior may differ across torch/vLLM lines.
A variance pilot on 0.19.1 cannot justify repetition adequacy for a final run planned on 0.25.1.
non_claims: This design does not authorize Kaggle execution.
This design does not invalidate the historical accepted P5/P6 result.
This design does not claim vLLM 0.25.1+cu129 is currently materialized.
This design does not claim the planned runtime will pass P5/P6 qualification.
This design does not alter the 342-trajectory final benchmark plan.
This design does not accept the variance pilot or freeze repetition counts.
reason: The final A/B/C preflight-v3 plan is bound to a different vLLM/torch runtime than the governed P5/P6 successor runtime that was actually executed and accepted.

Freeze an offline Kaggle runtime lock for the exact planned runtime.
